mutations.description: Mutate rtLeadingEntropy denominator from 4 * gN to 2 * gN
mutations.target:
def rtLeadingEntropy (area gN : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  area / (4 * gN)
mutations.replacement:
def rtLeadingEntropy (area gN : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  area / (2 * gN)

mutations.description: Mutate brownHenneauxCentralCharge numerator from 3 * rAds to 2 * rAds
mutations.target:
def brownHenneauxCentralCharge (rAds gN3 : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  (3 * rAds) / (2 * gN3)
mutations.replacement:
def brownHenneauxCentralCharge (rAds gN3 : ℚ) : ℚ :=
  (2 * rAds) / (2 * gN3)

mutations.description: Mutate rational_rt_match_iff_pure_and_zero_area from area = 0 to area = 1
mutations.target: entropy s = ((rtLeadingEntropy area gN : ℚ) : ℝ) ↔ Pure s ∧ area = 0 := by
mutations.replacement: entropy s = ((rtLeadingEntropy area gN : ℚ) : ℝ) ↔ Pure s ∧ area = 1 := by

mutations.description: Mutate orthogonal_pentatope_hinge_areas_sq equilateral area from 3 / 4 to 1 / 4

mutations.target: lam ^ 4 * cayleyMengerTriangleAreaSq s01 s02 s12 := by
mutations.replacement: lam ^ 2 * cayleyMengerTriangleAreaSq s01 s02 s12 := by
